versions.changelog:
yy-world-cup v1.0.6

- Added strict timezone handling to ensure all times are in Beijing Time; implemented UTC <-> BJT conversion.
- Introduced utilities for timezone management (`predictor/utils/timezone.py`).
- Updated Polymarket data client to support dynamic match schedule fetching with correct time handling.
- Enhanced predictor logic with differentiated betting strategies and improved estimation of Chinese Sports Lottery odds.
- Removed deprecated documentation file (`skill-card.md`).

No code or documentation changes in this version.

- Version bump only; no updates detected in files or documentation.

- Added predictor/simple_predictor.py module.
- Introduces a basic prediction script within the codebase.
- No changes to existing functionality.

yy-world-cup v1.0.3

- Added new modules for auto-evolution, weather data integration, and machine learning enhancements.
- Updated core prediction logic and data interfaces for improved flexibility.
- Expanded data layer with weather data client.
- Removed outdated documentation file (skill-card.md).

- Added documentation file: docs/MODEL_v3.1.md  
- No code or logic changes; update purely adds new model documentation.

World Cup Predictor Enhanced v3.0 introduces major market calibration and data source integration:

- Added Polymarket API integration for real-time market odds and probability calibration.
- Added a market calibration module to compare model, Polymarket, and China Sports Lottery prices.
- Automated cross-market value/EV opportunity detection.
- Enhanced demonstration script and expanded unit tests (including market data coverage).
- Removed outdated documentation (skill-card.md).

world-cup-predictor-enhanced v2.0

- Major upgrade featuring modular architecture with data, factors, strategy, and validator layers.
- Fixed odds mapping bug causing all odds to return as 20.0.
- Added tactical counter-relationship, group ranking incentive, and offense/defense data as predictive factors.
- Improved support for neutral venues by reducing home field advantage in World Cup scenarios.
- Fully encapsulates official FIFA API (balldontlie) with file-based caching.
- Achieved 100% unit test coverage (16 test cases) and validated against 2022 World Cup history.
- Generates dual ticket strategies for China Sports Lottery: high-win-rate (conservative) and aggressive, considering player injuries and weather impact.
